description: Database foundation and type system for stickers. Creates Supabase migration with sticker_assets and journal_sticker_placements tables, storage buckets (stickers-builtin public, stickers-custom private), RLS policies (owner_access pattern), and TypeScript types (StickerAsset, StickerPlacement, StickerLayout, etc.). This feature establishes the data model and authorization layer that all subsequent features depend on.
steps: Create supabase/migrations/20261012000001_add_sticker_system.sql with sticker_assets table (id, user_id nullable, storage_path, mime_type, width, height, created_at), journal_sticker_placements table (id, journal_entry_id FK, sticker_asset_id FK, x/y/width/rotation/z_index normalized, created_at), sticker_layout JSONB column on journal_entries, indexes on user_id and journal_entry_id
Add storage buckets: stickers-builtin (public read for authenticated), stickers-custom (private, user folders {user_id}/)

Add RLS policies: sticker_assets (authenticated can read all, insert/update/delete only own where user_id = auth.uid()), journal_sticker_placements (users can read/write only for entries they own via FK join to journal_entries.user_id = auth.uid())
Create frontend/src/types/sticker.types.ts with StickerAsset, StickerPlacement, StickerLayout, StickerSurface, StickerCategory interfaces. All fields typed from database schema.
Update frontend/src/types/index.ts to re-export all sticker types
acceptance_criteria: sticker_assets and journal_sticker_placements tables created with correct columns, constraints, indexes
Storage buckets created with correct access policies
RLS policies enforce ownership (cannot read/write other users' custom stickers or placements)
TypeScript types compile without errors: cd frontend && npm run build succeeds
Running cd frontend && npm run check:supabase shows no missing-table errors for sticker_assets or journal_sticker_placements
verification: cd frontend && npm run build — compiles without TypeScript errors
cd frontend && npm run check:supabase — no missing-table errors for sticker tables
findings: Migration created at supabase/migrations/20261012000001_add_sticker_system.sql with sticker_assets and journal_sticker_placements tables, RLS policies using owner_access pattern with is_account_active() checks, storage buckets (stickers-builtin and stickers-custom) with appropriate policies, and validation triggers. TypeScript types created at frontend/src/types/sticker.types.ts with all necessary interfaces exported through frontend/src/types/index.ts. Build verification passed with no errors.
